## Get numbat reference data

note that numbat does not work for the mouse samples: https://github.com/kharchenkolab/numbat/issues/198

```{bash other_meth_get_vcf}
#| eval: FALSE
# hg38
wget \
  -O input/numbat/genome1K.phase3.SNP_AF5e2.chr1toX.hg38.vcf.gz \
  https://sourceforge.net/projects/cellsnp/files/SNPlist/genome1K.phase3.SNP_AF5e2.chr1toX.hg38.vcf.gz

# hg38
#!!!! Had to download this using a web browser
# wget \
#   --no-check-certificate \
#   -O input/numbat/1000G_hg38.zip \
#   http://pklab.med.harvard.edu/teng/data/1000G_hg38.zip
```

## Get numbat container
```{bash other_meth_container}
#| eval: FALSE
#sbatch sbatchCmds/build_numbat_sing_container.sh
apptainer pull pkharchenkolab/numbat-rbase:latest numbat-rbase_latest.sif
```

```{r other_meth_numbat_save_counts}
human_samples <-
  read_tsv("misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(align_ref == "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-hg38") %>%
  pull(Sample_ID) %>%
  unique()

for (this_sample in human_samples) {
    qs2::qs_read(
      paste0(
        "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
        this_sample,
        "_human.qs2"
      )
    ) %>%
    GetAssayData(layer = "counts") %>%
    saveRDS(paste0(
      "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/rdata/counts/",
      this_sample,
      "_human_counts.rds"
    ))
}
```


```{bash other_meth_numbat}
human_data=(
  $(grep 10x-hg38 misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv \
    | cut -f 3 \
    | sort \
    | uniq \
    | grep -v Sample_ID \
  )
)

sbatch \
  --array=0-$((${#human_data[@]}-1)) \
  analysis_modules/10_cmp_other_methods/scripts/array_numbat.sh
```
